mapper.sql: source_id, title, description, function_module, problem_type, usage_stage, severity_level, issue_category, masking_status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT source_id, CASE WHEN masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 THEN title ELSE NULL END title, CASE WHEN masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 THEN description ELSE NULL END description, CASE WHEN masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 THEN function_module ELSE NULL END function_module, CASE WHEN masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 THEN problem_type ELSE NULL END problem_type, CASE WHEN masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 THEN usage_stage ELSE NULL END usage_stage, CASE WHEN masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 THEN severity_level ELSE NULL END severity_level, CASE WHEN masking_status='PASS' AND is_deleted=0 THEN issue_category ELSE NULL END issue_category, masking_status,is_deleted,created_at,updated_at FROM t_feedback_content WHERE source_id IN #{id} ORDER BY source_id
